verdict.rationale: Headless or CI-driven automation is a fair question for an online government service portal, since such portals could expose APIs or web services for programmatic use, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only interactive web portal features (login, notifications, service access). The llms.txt probe returned 404, and nothing documents a headless, API, or CI automation mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
